deploy-bot: Canary rollout embeddings-service v3.4.1 -> prod started. monitor p95 baseline=120ms. auto-rollback if p95>250ms or err_rate>0.5%.
oliver: seeing eu p95=340ms, err_rate ~0.8% over 5m :eyes:
maya: pausing canary and taking operator lead. executing pause now.
maya: `rwctl rollout pause --canary embeds-3.4.1`
oncall-bot: Command accepted: canary embeds-3.4.1 paused by maya at 2024-05-10T14:12:31Z
maya: pinning eu to v3.4.0 to restore SLAs.
maya: `rwctl route set /embeddings --model=v3.4.0 --region=eu --weight=100`
oncall-bot: Routing update: /embeddings -> v3.4.0 (eu) applied
sam: drafting customer-facing blurb for #status. will paste in 2m.
jun: opened ticket INC-4321, attached traces and p95 graph: https://internal/traces/INC-4321
oliver: quick check — does this touch Dedicated pools? I think only Hosted EU. pinging eng-dedicated.
maya: correct, hosted eu only. Dedicated unaffected. I'll update the release notes after we stabilise.
deploy-bot: Auto-rollback suppressed by operator (reason=manual_intervene). policies unchanged.
maya: plan: staged rollback (EU now). monitor 10m. if p95 < 180ms and err_rate < 0.2% we keep. otherwise escalate to global rollback.
sam: status note ready: "We paused a canary in EU due to latency spike. Rolling back EU to v3.4.0 to restore latency. Other regions unaffected. ETA 30m." posting to #status now :mega:
jun: adding links in ticket and tagging product for release notes: https://docs/release/3.4.1
oliver: watching metrics. will call for global rollback if we see secondary spikes in US within 15m.
maya: I'll follow up with a short postmortem once we have logs. thanks all — handing watch to oliver. :handshake:
